links.comparator_used: Lower levels of reasoning effort on the same models (three effort levels compared)
links.outcome: Erasure of correct cells when reviewing extracted genomic tables under partial evidence
links.effect: Raising reasoning effort reduced erasure in only three models; token cost rose 1.1 to 21.5 times
links.tradeoff: 1.1 to 21.5 times more tokens at higher reasoning effort
links.quote: A keep sentence brought erasure to zero in 10 of the 13 models; raising reasoning effort cost 1.1 to 21.5 times more tokens and reduced erasure in only three models.
